description: Courier, Cloning, Migration, and BCDR extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.
section_title: Move, Branch, and Protect Your Databases
section_subtitle: Courier, Cloning, Migration, and BCDR extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.

capabilities.title: KubeDB Courier
capabilities.description: The data movement engine of KubeDB. Courier runs live database migration declaratively through Kubernetes custom resources, so every data move is versioned, observable, and repeatable.
benefits: One operator for data movement workflows, starting with live migration
Declarative CRDs with status you can watch with kubectl
Moves data from external databases into KubeDB-managed ones
Enabled with a single Helm flag: kubedb-courier.enabled=true

capabilities.title: Database Cloning and Branching
capabilities.description: Clone production data safely for development and testing, on the same Kubernetes platform that runs your databases. Isolated, refreshable branches are on the roadmap.
benefits: Safe copies of production data for dev, test, and upgrade rehearsal
Same declarative operating model as every other KubeDB database
Branching, with isolated writable copies, is on the roadmap

capabilities.title: Live Database Migration
capabilities.description: Move an existing database from AWS RDS, another cloud, or an on-premises host into a KubeDB-managed database while the source keeps serving traffic.
benefits: Schema copy, initial snapshot, then continuous change data capture
No maintenance window, the source stays live until cutover
Cut over once streaming lag reaches zero, typically within minutes
Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and MSSQL Server

capabilities.title: BCDR: Near-Zero RPO and RTO for Databases
capabilities.description: Survive the loss of an entire data center with near-zero RPO and RTO. Choose automatic failover decided by a 3-site quorum, or manual failover decided by your team, with zero data loss available through synchronous replication.
benefits: Option A, automatic: a 3-site etcd quorum decides which data center is primary, with fail-closed split-brain protection and no human in the loop
Option B, manual: Remote Replica across two independent clusters, with synchronous mode for zero data loss
Cross-data-center DR for PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, MongoDB, and OpenSearch, plus active-active distributed SQL
Planned switchover with zero data loss, then failback with pg_rewind or re-seed
